True def transform(grid):
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    cols = [c for row in grid for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 3]
    r0, r1 = min(rows), max(rows)
    c0, c1 = min(cols), max(cols)
    return [[grid[len(grid) - 1 - r][c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
